title: CRIC Ontology Evolution and Governance
summary: Governance contracts for evolving the CRIC ontology: gap results, proposals, lifecycle states, review triggers, PR workflow, versioning, deprecation and migration.
notes: Competing signals: sits in the CRIC-PRD-v0.1 family and ends with a 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section (PRD signal), but the dominant content is implementation contracts — typed YAML schemas (gap result, deprecation metadata), required-field lists for OntologyProposal, a closed lifecycle state sequence, semantic-versioning rules and required automated checks. No ADR signals (no status frontmatter, no Decision/Consequences), no user stories. Ambiguity resolved to SPEC per SPEC > PRD precedence.
